title.zh: 公共负担：领福利会影响绿卡吗？（2026年新规）
title.en: Public charge: will benefits affect my green card? (2026 rule)

short.zh: 2026年9月18日起规定改变，申请绿卡前必读
short.en: Rules changed Sept 18, 2026: read before applying for a green card

summary.zh: “公共负担”是移民局审查**绿卡申请**时，判断申请人将来会不会依赖政府福利的标准。**2026 年 9 月 18 日起规定改变了**：旧规只看现金补助和长期护理，新规下白卡、粮食券、WIC、公屋等以收入审核的福利都**可能**被考虑。但很多人**根本不受公共负担影响**，先看下面谁不受影响。
summary.en: "Public charge" is the test immigration officers use on **green card applications** to judge whether someone may depend on government benefits. **It changed on September 18, 2026**: the old rule counted only cash aid and long-term care; under the new approach, means-tested benefits such as Medicaid, SNAP, WIC and public housing **may** be considered. But many people **aren't subject to public charge at all**; check below first.

zh: 2026 年 7 月 20 日联邦公布最终规定，**废除 2022 年的规则**，改由移民官员**综合个案判断**，没有固定清单。
**2026 年 9 月 18 日或之后**递交的绿卡申请适用新标准；之前递交的仍按旧规。
**9 月 18 日以前领取的福利**，仍按旧规判断：只有现金补助（SSI、TANF 等）和长期护理才算。
纽约州联合二十多个州和华盛顿特区起诉，纽约市等城市另案起诉；截至本文核实时，法院尚未阻止新规。
en: A final rule published July 20, 2026 **rescinded the 2022 rule**; officers now decide **case by case** with no fixed list.
Green card applications filed **on or after Sept 18, 2026** use the new standard; earlier filings use the old rule.
**Benefits received before Sept 18, 2026** are still judged under the old rule: only cash aid (SSI, TANF, etc.) and long-term care count.
New York, about 20 other states and DC have sued, and NYC and other cities filed a separate suit; no court had blocked the rule when this was checked.

zh: **不受公共负担影响的人**：已经有绿卡、申请入籍（入籍不审查公共负担）、难民、庇护者、SIJ 少年、T 签证和 U 签证持有人、VAWA 自我申请者等
**主要受影响**：通过亲属移民或其他途径**正在或准备申请绿卡**的人
**一般不算福利**：社安退休金、政府退休金、失业金、退伍军人福利等非收入审核的项目
移民官员**可能**会把申请人有法律责任照顾的家人（例如美国出生的孩子）领的福利也算进去；但不要自行停掉孩子的福利，先咨询免费律师
en: **Not subject to public charge**: people who already have a green card, naturalization applicants, refugees, asylees, SIJ youth, T and U visa holders, VAWA self-petitioners and others
**Mainly affected**: people **applying or planning to apply for a green card** through family or other routes
**Not counted**: Social Security, government pensions, unemployment insurance, veterans' benefits and other non-means-tested benefits

Officers **may** count benefits used by family members the applicant is legally responsible for (e.g., U.S.-citizen children); don't drop your children's benefits on your own, talk to a free lawyer first

zh: **先判断自己属不属于受影响的人**；已有绿卡准备入籍的，不受影响
准备申请绿卡、又需要或正在领福利的，**先打免费移民法律热线咨询**，不要自己贸然退掉孩子的保险或食物补助
急诊、疫苗、学校午餐等基本保障，不要因为害怕而放弃
en: **First check whether you're affected**; green card holders applying for citizenship are not
If you're applying for a green card and use or need benefits, **call a free immigration legal hotline first**; don't cancel your children's coverage or food help on your own
Don't skip emergency care, vaccines or school meals out of fear

label.zh: 纽约州新美国人热线（免费、匿名，有中文）
纽约市移民法律支援热线（有中文）

zh: “领了福利就不能入籍”：入籍不审查公共负担
“有绿卡的人领福利会被取消绿卡”：公共负担主要审查申请绿卡的人，已有绿卡者一般不受影响；但**出国超过 180 天**再入境时，可能被当作重新申请入境而接受审查
“新规公布后以前领的都算”：9 月 18 日前领的按旧规，只有现金补助和长期护理算
en: "Benefits block citizenship": naturalization has no public charge test

"Green card holders lose their cards for using benefits": the test mainly applies to green card applicants; but a green card holder returning from **more than 180 days abroad** can be treated as seeking admission and face it
"Everything I used before counts now": benefits before Sept 18, 2026 are judged under the old rule

title.zh: 申请入籍（N-400）

short.zh: 绿卡满5年（配偶3年）可申请；费用可能大涨
short.en: Green card 5 years (3 if married to a citizen); fees may rise sharply

summary.zh: 持绿卡满 **5 年**（与美国公民结婚并同住满 **3 年**）就可以申请入籍，可提前 90 天递交。入籍后可以投票、为父母子女申请绿卡、拿美国护照。**移民局已提议大幅提高入籍费并取消大部分减费**，打算申请的人值得早做准备。
summary.en: After **5 years** with a green card (**3 years** if married to and living with a U.S. citizen) you can apply for citizenship, up to 90 days early. Citizens can vote, sponsor parents and children, and get a U.S. passport. **USCIS has proposed a big fee increase and ending most reduced fees**, so plan ahead.

zh: **费用提案（尚未定案）**：入籍费拟提高到网上 $1,280、纸本 $1,330，并**取消大部分减费和免费申请**。
**新公民考试**：2025 年 10 月 20 日或之后递交的申请，用新版考试：从 128 题中考 20 题，答对 12 题及格。
据报道 2026 年第二季度入籍批准数大跌，排队案件增加，审理可能变慢。
en: **Fee proposal (not final)**: $1,280 online and $1,330 on paper, **ending most reduced fees and fee waivers**.
**New civics test**: applications filed on or after Oct 20, 2025 take the 2025 test: 20 questions from 128, 12 correct to pass.
Reports say approvals dropped sharply in spring 2026 and backlogs grew, so processing may be slower.

zh: 18 岁以上
绿卡满 5 年；或与公民结婚同住满 3 年
过去 5 年内在美国住满 30 个月（3 年途径为 18 个月）
出境 1 年以上会中断连续居住；6–12 个月可能被认为中断
递交前在本州住满 3 个月
**英文考试豁免**：50 岁以上且绿卡满 20 年，或 55 岁以上且满 15 年，可以免考英文；65 岁以上且满 20 年，公民考试题目更少，可用母语
en: Age 18+
Green card 5 years, or 3 years married to and living with a citizen
Physically present 30 months of the last 5 years (18 of 3)
A trip of 1 year+ breaks continuous residence; 6–12 months may
3 months in your state before filing
**English exemptions**: 50+ with 20 years as a green card holder, or 55+ with 15 years; 65+ with 20 years gets a shorter civics test in their own language

zh: 上 USCIS 网站建立账户，网上递交 N-400（网上比纸本便宜）
目前费用：网上 $710、纸本 $760；家庭收入在贫困线 150–400% 可申请减费 $380（以 USCIS 官网为准）
**2025 年 10 月 28 日起移民局不收支票和汇票**，要用信用卡或银行转账
按通知去打指纹、面试，通过后参加宣誓
en: Create a USCIS online account and file N-400 online (cheaper than paper)
Current fee: $710 online, $760 paper; $380 reduced fee for income 150–400% of poverty (confirm on uscis.gov)
**Since Oct 28, 2025 USCIS doesn't accept checks or money orders**; pay by card or bank debit
Attend biometrics and interview, then the oath ceremony

zh: 绿卡正反面
过去 5 年的出入境记录
婚姻证明（3 年途径）
报税记录，如有逮捕或法庭记录要准备文件
en: Green card (both sides)
Travel history for 5 years
Marriage proof (3-year route)
Tax records; court records if you were ever arrested

zh: “领过福利不能入籍”：入籍不审查公共负担
“找中介比律师好”：只有律师或司法部认可代表才能代理，中介只能填表翻译
en: "Benefits block citizenship": naturalization has no public charge test
"A notario is as good as a lawyer": only lawyers or DOJ-accredited representatives may represent you

title.zh: 申请绿卡（I-485 调整身份）基本知识
title.en: Green card basics (I-485 adjustment of status)

short.zh: 主要途径、费用和2026年新变化
short.en: Main paths, fees and 2026 changes

summary.zh: 在美国境内申请绿卡叫“调整身份”（I-485）。主要途径有**亲属移民、职业移民、难民/庇护转绿卡、抽签**等。成人 I-485 费用 **$1,440**。2026 年有新表格版本和公共负担新规，递交前务必确认。
summary.en: Applying for a green card from inside the U.S. is "adjustment of status" (I-485). Main paths are **family, employment, refugee/asylum, and the diversity lottery**. The adult I-485 fee is **$1,440**. A new form edition and public charge rule took effect in 2026, so double-check before filing.

zh: **2026 年 9 月 18 日起只收新版 I-485**（版本日期 09/18/26），旧版会被退回，没有宽限期。
同日起适用新的公共负担标准，请先看《公共负担》指南。
部分国家国民的申请被暂停审理；据报道中国、香港、澳门不在名单上。
en: **Only the 09/18/26 edition of I-485 is accepted from Sept 18, 2026**; older editions are rejected, with no grace period.
The new public charge standard applies from the same date; see our public charge guide.
Cases from some travel-ban countries were put on hold; China, Hong Kong and Macau are reported not to be on the list.

zh: 亲属移民：**美国公民**可以为配偶、子女、父母（公民须满 21 岁）、兄弟姐妹申请；**绿卡持有人只能为配偶和未婚子女申请**
职业移民：雇主担保或特殊人才
难民和庇护者：获批 1 年后可申请
抽签移民：国务院推迟了 2027 年度（DV-2027）登记；法院已下令 2026 年 11 月 1 日起开放 30 天，但政府已上诉，请以国务院官方公告为准
en: Family: **U.S. citizens** can sponsor spouses, children, parents (if the citizen is 21+) and siblings; **green card holders can sponsor only spouses and unmarried children**
Employment: employer-sponsored or extraordinary ability
Refugees and asylees: after 1 year

Diversity lottery: the State Department delayed DV-2027 registration; a court ordered it to open Nov 1, 2026 for 30 days, but the government has appealed. Follow the State Department's official notice

zh: 确认途径和排期（亲属和职业移民要看每月的签证公告）
用**最新版**表格；费用参考：I-485 成人 $1,440、14 岁以下随父母 $950；I-130 网上 $625、纸本 $675；随 I-485 申请工卡 $260、回美证 $630（以 USCIS 官网为准）
只能用信用卡或银行转账付款
用收据号码在 USCIS 网站查进度
en: Confirm your path and priority date (check the monthly Visa Bulletin)

Use the **current** forms. Reference fees: I-485 $1,440 adult, $950 child under 14 with a parent; I-130 $625 online, $675 paper; work permit with I-485 $260; advance parole $630 (confirm on uscis.gov)
Pay by card or bank debit only
Track your case with the receipt number on the USCIS site

zh: 护照、出生证明、I-94 入境记录
体检表 I-693
经济担保 I-864
照片
亲属关系或工作证明
en: Passport, birth certificate, I-94
Medical exam I-693
Affidavit of support I-864
Photos
Proof of relationship or job

zh: “交钱可以加快排期”：排期由法律和签证公告决定，任何人都不能收钱插队
“随便找人填表就好”：表格版本、付款方式出错都会被退件，复杂个案请找律师
en: "Pay to speed up": priority dates are set by law; nobody can sell you a faster place
"Anyone can fill the forms": wrong editions or payment methods get rejected; see a lawyer for complex cases

title.zh: 免费移民法律帮助和防移民诈骗
title.en: Free immigration legal help and avoiding fraud

short.zh: 免费热线、中文服务机构，教你识别假律师
short.en: Free hotlines, Chinese-language groups, spotting fake lawyers

summary.zh: 移民案件出错可能影响一辈子。纽约州和纽约市都有**免费、保密、有中文**的移民法律热线，法拉盛、华埠也有多家中文非营利机构。注意：**公证人（notario）不是律师**，只有律师或司法部认可的代表才能代理移民案件。
summary.en: Immigration mistakes can last a lifetime. New York State and City run **free, confidential hotlines with Chinese**, and several Chinese-language nonprofits serve Flushing and Chinatown. Remember: **a notary ("notario") is not a lawyer**; only lawyers or DOJ-accredited representatives may handle immigration cases.

zh: 任何移民，不论身份
部分市政府法律中心服务收入在贫困线 200% 以内的家庭
en: Any immigrant, any status
Some City legal centers serve households under 200% of poverty

zh: 先打免费热线说明情况，会转介合适的律师或机构
带齐所有移民文件和收到的信件
签约前要求书面合同（英文和你的语言），并拿回所有原件
en: Call a free hotline first; they'll refer you to a lawyer or organization
Bring all immigration papers and letters
Before paying anyone, get a written contract in English and your language, and keep your originals

label.zh: 纽约州新美国人热线（免费、匿名、200多种语言）
label.en: NYS New Americans Hotline (free, anonymous, 200+ languages)

label.zh: 纽约市移民法律支援热线
ActionNYC 免费入籍和绿卡协助
民权中心 MinKwon Center，法拉盛
华人进步会（曼哈顿华埠，粤语/普通话）
举报移民诈骗：纽约州检察长热线
label.en: Report immigration fraud: NY Attorney General

zh: “公证人能办移民”：公证人不是律师，只能填表和翻译
“保证批准”：任何保证结果、说有内部关系的都是警讯
“先签空白表格”：绝对不要签空白或内容不实的表格
en: "A notario can handle my case": notaries aren't lawyers and may only fill forms and translate
"Guaranteed approval": promises or "inside connections" are red flags
"Just sign the blank form": never sign blank or false forms

纽约州检察长：移民服务诈骗

title.zh: 白卡（纽约州 Medicaid）

short.zh: 低收入免费医疗保险；2026年10月起对移民规定有变
short.en: Free health coverage for low income; rules for immigrants changed Oct 2026

summary.zh: 白卡（Medicaid）是给低收入人士的免费医疗保险，看病、住院、买药基本不用自己付钱。19–64 岁成人的收入标准是联邦贫困线的 **138%**，单人每月约 **$1,836**。2025 年通过的联邦新法案从 2026 年起陆续改了不少规定，下面先看“最新变化”。
summary.en: Medicaid is free health coverage for people with low income: doctor visits, hospital care and prescriptions with little or no cost. Adults 19–64 qualify up to **138% of the poverty line**, about **$1,836 a month** for one person. A 2025 federal law changed several rules; see "What changed recently" first.

zh: **2026 年 10 月 1 日起**，难民、庇护者、假释入境者等不再享有联邦白卡；纽约州表示会把他们转到 Essential Plan，福利不变。儿童和孕妇不受影响。
**2027 年 1 月 1 日起**，19–64 岁的扩展白卡成人需要每月工作、上学、培训或做义工满 **80 小时**（或月收入至少 $580），并改为**每 6 个月续一次**。65 岁以上、孕妇、残障、照顾 14 岁以下孩子等人豁免。
**小提示**：在 **2027 年 1 月 1 日前申请**、或在 **2027 年 3 月 1 日前续期**的人，会先获得 12 个月保障。
en: **From Oct 1, 2026**, refugees, asylees, parolees and some others lost federally funded Medicaid; New York says they move to the Essential Plan with the same benefits. Children and pregnant people are not affected.

**From Jan 1, 2027**, expansion adults 19–64 must work, study, train or volunteer **80 hours a month** (or earn at least $580) and renew **every 6 months**. People 65+, pregnant, disabled, caring for a child under 14 and others are exempt.
**Tip**: people who **apply before January 1, 2027** or **renew before March 1, 2027** get 12 months of coverage first.

zh: 65 岁以上、失明或残障：单人月收入 $1,836、两人 $2,489 以下，资产单人 $33,038、两人 $44,796 以下
**身份**：公民、满 5 年的绿卡持有人、古巴/海地入境者等可获联邦白卡
**没有身份的 65 岁以上长者、孕妇（含产后 12 个月内）和儿童**，纽约州用州政府资金提供白卡或儿童保险。注意：2026 年 10 月 31 日起，在护理院住满 3 个月以上的无身份 65 岁以上长者改为只保紧急医疗
DACA、PRUCOL 等身份按收入可获州资助白卡；绿卡未满 5 年的，可能由州资金覆盖，申请时请确认
其他没有身份的成人，符合收入和居住条件的可申请**紧急白卡**（急诊）
en: 65+, blind or disabled: income up to $1,836 (1) or $2,489 (2) a month; assets up to $33,038 (1) or $44,796 (2)
**Status**: citizens, green card holders past the 5-year wait, Cuban/Haitian entrants and some others get federal Medicaid

**Undocumented people 65+, pregnant people (up to 12 months after birth) and children** get state-funded coverage in New York. Note: from Oct 31, 2026, undocumented people 65+ in a nursing home for 3+ months are limited to emergency coverage
DACA and PRUCOL may get state-funded Medicaid based on income; green card holders under 5 years may be covered by state funds, so ask when you apply
Other undocumented adults who meet income and residency rules can get **Emergency Medicaid**

zh: **65 岁以下**：上 NY State of Health（nystateofhealth.ny.gov）网上申请，或打电话，可以要求免费中文翻译
**纽约市 65 岁以上**或有 Medicare 而没有未成年子女：向 HRA 申请，可网上（ACCESS HRA）、电话、到办公室或邮寄
纽约市以外：向所在县的社会服务局（DSS）申请
收到续期信件一定要按时回复，否则会断保
en: **Under 65**: apply at NY State of Health (nystateofhealth.ny.gov) or by phone; ask for a free interpreter
**NYC, 65+** or on Medicare without minor children: apply with HRA online (ACCESS HRA), by phone, in person or by mail
Outside NYC: your county Department of Social Services
Always answer renewal letters on time or coverage ends

zh: 身份证明（护照、绿卡等）
收入证明（工资单、雇主信、报税表）
住址证明
65 岁以上需要银行等资产证明
en: ID (passport, green card, etc.)
Proof of income (pay stubs, employer letter, tax return)
Proof of address
For 65+, proof of assets such as bank statements

label.zh: HRA 医疗保险热线（纽约市65岁以上）

zh: “没身份不能看病”：在纽约，儿童、孕妇和 65 岁以上长者不论身份都有保障；其他人符合收入和居住条件也能用紧急白卡看急诊
“领白卡会影响绿卡”：2026 年 9 月起公共负担规定有变，正在申请或准备申请绿卡的人请先看《公共负担》指南并咨询免费律师
“一次批准一直有效”：要按时续期，2027 年起成人每 6 个月一次
en: "No status, no care": in NY, children, pregnant people and seniors 65+ are covered regardless of status, and others who meet income and residency rules can use Emergency Medicaid
"Medicaid will hurt my green card": public charge rules changed in Sept 2026; if you're applying for a green card, read our public charge guide and talk to a free lawyer first
"Approved once, covered forever": you must renew; adults every 6 months from 2027

sources.name: 纽约州 2026 年白卡收入标准（26MA05）

title.zh: Essential Plan 基本医疗计划

short.zh: 收入略高于白卡标准的成人，保费 $0
short.en: $0 premium coverage for adults just above Medicaid income

summary.zh: Essential Plan 是纽约州给 19–64 岁、收入在联邦贫困线 **200% 以下**但不符合白卡的人的医疗保险，**保费 $0**。单人年收入约 **$31,920** 以下。
summary.en: The Essential Plan covers adults 19–64 with income up to **200% of the poverty line** who don't qualify for Medicaid, with a **$0 premium**. That's about **$31,920 a year** for one person.

zh: **2026 年 7 月 1 日起**，收入在贫困线 200–250% 的约 45 万人离开 Essential Plan，转到市场上的保险计划（QHP）。
**2026 年 10 月起**，失去联邦白卡的难民、庇护者等转到 Essential Plan，福利不变。
部分 DACA 人士可能失去保障，请尽快联络 NY State of Health 或免费的保险协助员。
**2027 年起**，联邦资金只覆盖绿卡持有人、古巴/海地入境者和自由联合国家公民；收入超过贫困线 138% 的其他合法移民可能失去 Essential Plan。纽约州表示计划用州资金补上，细节尚未确定。
en: **Since July 1, 2026**, about 450,000 people at 200–250% of poverty moved from the Essential Plan to marketplace plans (QHPs).
**Since October 2026**, refugees and asylees who lost federal Medicaid move to the Essential Plan with the same benefits.
Some DACA recipients may lose coverage; contact NY State of Health or a free navigator soon.

**From 2027**, federal funding covers only green card holders, Cuban/Haitian entrants and COFA citizens; other lawfully present immigrants above 138% of poverty may lose the Essential Plan. New York says it plans to use state funds, but details aren't final.

zh: 收入在联邦贫困线 200% 以内，且不符合白卡
合法居留的移民（目前包括绿卡、难民、庇护等；2027 年起可能改变，见上方）
**没有身份的成人不符合**（可看《NYC Care》）
en: Ages 19–64
Income up to 200% of poverty and not Medicaid-eligible
Lawfully present immigrants (currently including green card holders, refugees and asylees; this may change in 2027, see above)
**Undocumented adults are not eligible** (see NYC Care)

zh: 上 NY State of Health 网上申请，或打电话，可要求中文翻译
全年都可以申请
收入改变要主动更新资料
en: Apply at NY State of Health online or by phone; ask for an interpreter
You can apply any time of year
Report income changes

sources.name: 纽约州卫生厅 2026 年 3 月新闻稿

title.zh: 儿童医疗保险（Child Health Plus）

short.zh: 19岁以下孩子不论身份都能投保，很多家庭免费
short.en: Coverage for kids under 19 regardless of status; free for many families

summary.zh: 纽约州 19 岁以下的孩子，**不论移民身份**，只要不符合白卡又没有其他保险，就能参加 Child Health Plus。收入较低的家庭**免费**，较高的每个孩子每月 $15 起，**没有自付额**，全年都能申请。
summary.en: Children under 19 in New York, **regardless of immigration status**, can join Child Health Plus if they don't qualify for Medicaid and have no other insurance. Lower-income families pay **nothing**; others pay from $15 per child a month, with **no copays**. Enroll any time.

zh: 19 岁以下、住在纽约州
不符合白卡、没有其他保险
不问移民身份
免费标准举例：2 人家庭年收入约 $46,953 以下（每月约 $3,913）；超过的按收入分级付保费，每个孩子每月 $15 起，每家最多付 3 个孩子（以官方最新表格为准）
en: Under 19 and living in New York
Not Medicaid-eligible, no other insurance
Any immigration status
Free example: a household of 2 up to about $46,953 a year (about $3,913 a month); above that, premiums by income from $15 per child a month, for at most 3 children (check the current official chart)

zh: 上 NY State of Health 申请，或找医院、保险公司的协助员
全年都可以申请
en: Apply through NY State of Health, or with a hospital or plan navigator
Enrollment is open all year

title.zh: NYC Care 纽约市医疗服务计划

short.zh: 没有保险、也买不到保险的人，不问身份看病
short.en: Care for people who can't get insurance, regardless of status

summary.zh: NYC Care 不是保险，而是纽约市公立医院（NYC Health + Hospitals）的**看病计划**，给不符合任何保险的人。**不问移民身份**，按收入浮动收费，可以低到 **$0**，有自己的家庭医生。
summary.en: NYC Care is not insurance; it's a care program at NYC Health + Hospitals for people who can't get any health plan. **Status isn't asked**, costs slide by income starting at **$0**, and you get your own primary care doctor.

zh: 住在纽约市五大区
不符合纽约州任何医疗保险，也没有雇主保险
不问移民身份
en: Lives in the five boroughs
Not eligible for any NY health plan and no job-based insurance
Immigration status isn't asked

zh: 或到任何 NYC Health + Hospitals 医院登记
带身份证明、住址证明、收入和家庭人数资料
en: Or enroll at any NYC Health + Hospitals location
Bring ID, proof of address, income and household size

title.zh: 红蓝卡（Medicare）省钱方案：MSP、EPIC、Extra Help
title.en: Help with Medicare costs: MSP, EPIC, Extra Help

short.zh: 65岁以上：帮付 Medicare 保费和药费
short.en: 65+: help paying Medicare premiums and drug costs

summary.zh: 有红蓝卡的长者，收入不高的话可以申请三种帮助：**Medicare 储蓄计划（MSP）**帮你付每月保费，**EPIC** 是纽约州的老人药费补助，**Extra Help** 帮付处方药费用。
summary.en: Seniors on Medicare with modest income can get three kinds of help: the **Medicare Savings Program (MSP)** pays monthly premiums, **EPIC** is New York's senior drug program, and **Extra Help** lowers prescription costs.

zh: 联邦新法规定，难民、庇护者、TPS 等身份将失去 Medicare（绿卡满 5 年者不受影响），社安退休金不变。具体时间表尚未最终确定，收到社安局信件请尽快找免费律师。
en: Under the new federal law, refugees, asylees, TPS holders and some others will lose Medicare (green card holders past 5 years are not affected); Social Security checks don't change. The timeline isn't final; if you get a letter from SSA, see a free lawyer soon.

zh: MSP：单人月收入约 $2,474、两人 $3,355 以下（2026 年），**纽约没有资产限制**
EPIC：65 岁以上并有 Part D 药物计划；单身年收入 $75,000、夫妇 $100,000 以下
Extra Help：单人月收入约 $2,015、夫妇约 $2,725 以下，资产单人 $18,090、夫妇 $36,100 以下
en: MSP: monthly income up to about $2,474 (1) or $3,355 (2) in 2026; **New York has no asset test**
EPIC: 65+ with a Part D plan; income up to $75,000 single or $100,000 married
Extra Help: income up to about $2,015 (single) or $2,725 (couple) a month; assets up to $18,090 or $36,100

zh: MSP：纽约市向 HRA 申请（有中文表格），其他地区向县社会服务局
EPIC：打 EPIC 热线索取申请表
Extra Help：向社安局（SSA）申请
en: MSP: in NYC apply with HRA (Chinese forms available); elsewhere, your county DSS
EPIC: call the EPIC helpline for an application
Extra Help: apply with Social Security

sources.name: 纽约州 2026 年收入标准（26MA05）

title.zh: 粮食券（SNAP）

short.zh: 每月充值到卡里买食物；2026年移民资格有大变化
short.en: Monthly food money on a card; big 2026 changes for immigrants

summary.zh: 粮食券（SNAP）每月把钱充到 EBT 卡上，在超市买食物用。2026 年 10 月起单人每月最多 **$306**、4 人最多 **$1,023**。联邦新法收紧了移民资格和工作要求，下面先看“最新变化”。
summary.en: SNAP puts money on an EBT card each month for groceries. From October 2026 the maximum is **$306** for one person and **$1,023** for four. A federal law tightened rules for immigrants and work; read "What changed recently" first.

zh: **移民资格收窄**：现在只有**绿卡持有人**、古巴/海地入境者和自由联合国家（密克罗尼西亚等）公民可以领。难民、庇护者等**拿到绿卡之前**不再符合。纽约从 2026 年 4 月起对新申请执行，已在领的人在下次续期时生效。
**法院判决**：2026 年 9 月联邦法院判决，原本是难民或庇护、后来拿到绿卡的人，仍然符合资格，而且不用等 5 年。是否会上诉还不确定。
**工作要求**：18–64 岁、家里没有 14 岁以下孩子的成人，每月要工作、培训或做义工满 **80 小时**，否则 3 年内只能领 3 个月。纽约市 2026 年 3 月起执行。
en: **Fewer immigrants qualify**: now mainly **green card holders**, Cuban/Haitian entrants and COFA citizens. Refugees and asylees **without a green card** no longer qualify. NY applied this to new applicants from April 2026; current cases change at recertification.
**Court ruling**: in Sept 2026 a federal court ruled that people who were refugees or asylees and later got a green card still qualify, without the 5-year wait. An appeal is possible.
**Work rule**: adults 18–64 with no child under 14 at home must work, train or volunteer **80 hours a month**, or SNAP is limited to 3 months in 3 years. NYC has enforced this since March 2026.

zh: 收入标准（2025年10月–2026年9月的数字，每月税前；2026年10月起的新标准略有上调，待纽约州公布）：有工作收入的家庭约 1人 $1,957、2人 $2,644、3人 $3,332、4人 $4,019；家里有老人、残障或付托儿费的，上限更高：1人 $2,608、4人 $5,358
身份：公民、绿卡持有人（一般要满 5 年；**18 岁以下孩子、领残障福利者、工作满 40 季的人不用等**）、古巴/海地入境者
**混合身份家庭**：父母没有身份，在美国出生的孩子仍然可以领，父母可以替孩子申请，不会问父母的身份
en: Income (monthly, before tax, for Oct 2025–Sep 2026; the Oct 2026 figures are slightly higher, pending NY's notice): households with earnings about 1 person $1,957, 2 $2,644, 3 $3,332, 4 $4,019; households with a senior, disabled member or child-care costs: up to $2,608 (1) or $5,358 (4)
Status: citizens, green card holders (usually after 5 years; **no wait for children under 18, people on disability benefits, or people with 40 work quarters**), Cuban/Haitian entrants
**Mixed-status families**: U.S.-born children can get SNAP even if parents have no status; parents can apply for the children without giving their own status

zh: 纽约市：用 ACCESS HRA 网站或手机 App 申请，网站有简体和繁体中文
或打 718-SNAP-NOW（718-762-7669），周一至五 8:30am–5pm，有免费翻译
申请后会有电话面谈，按时接听
批准后会寄 EBT 卡，每月自动充值
en: NYC: apply on the ACCESS HRA website or app, available in Chinese
Or call 718-SNAP-NOW (718-762-7669), Mon–Fri 8:30am–5pm, free interpreters
Answer the phone interview on time
Your EBT card is mailed and reloaded monthly

zh: 身份证明
全家收入证明
房租、水电账单（可以增加扣除额，领得更多）
移民身份文件（申请人本人）
en: ID
Income proof for the household
Rent and utility bills (deductions raise your benefit)
Immigration documents (for the person applying for themselves)

zh: “领了粮食券会被遣返”：粮食券不会通报移民执法；但正在申请绿卡的人，请先看《公共负担》指南
“家里有人没身份就都不能领”：有资格的家人（如美国出生的孩子）仍然可以领
“有工作就不能领”：收入不超过标准就可以，有工作的家庭标准反而较宽
en: "SNAP gets you deported": SNAP isn't an immigration enforcement tool; if you're applying for a green card, read our public charge guide first
"One undocumented member disqualifies everyone": eligible members such as U.S.-born children can still get it
"Working families can't get it": if income is under the limit you can, and working households have a higher limit

sources.name: 纽约州 SNAP 2026 财年标准
USDA 2027 财年 SNAP 调整
纽约市 SNAP 工作要求

title.zh: WIC 妇婴营养补助
title.en: WIC for moms, babies and young kids

short.zh: 孕妇和5岁以下孩子，不问身份
short.en: Pregnant people and kids under 5, any status

summary.zh: WIC 给**孕妇、产后妈妈和 5 岁以下孩子**提供牛奶、婴儿配方奶粉、蔬果等食物，以及营养和喂奶指导。**不问移民身份**。正在申请绿卡的家庭，请先看《公共负担》指南。
summary.en: WIC gives **pregnant people, new moms and children under 5** milk, formula, fruits, vegetables and more, plus nutrition and breastfeeding support. **Immigration status isn't asked.** If your family is applying for a green card, read our public charge guide first.

zh: 孕妇、产后 6 个月内的妈妈、哺乳 1 年内的妈妈、5 岁以下孩子（父亲、祖父母等主要照顾者都能替孩子申请）
家里有人领白卡、粮食券或现金补助的，自动符合收入标准
en: Pregnant people, moms up to 6 months after birth (1 year if breastfeeding), children under 5; any main caregiver can apply for a child
Automatically income-eligible if someone has Medicaid, SNAP or cash assistance
Otherwise yearly income up to 185% of poverty: $29,526 (1), $40,034 (2), $50,542 (3), $61,050 (4)

zh: 打 Growing Up Healthy 热线 1-800-522-5006 找附近 WIC 中心
或在纽约州 WIC 网站用线上助手登记
en: Call the Growing Up Healthy Hotline at 1-800-522-5006 to find a WIC site
Or sign up with the online assistant on the NYS WIC site

title.zh: 公立学校免费早餐和午餐

short.zh: 纽约州所有公立学校学生免费，不看收入
short.en: Free for every public school student in NY

summary.zh: 从 2025–26 学年起，**纽约州所有公立学校**学生的早餐和午餐都**免费**，不看家庭收入，不问身份，**不用申请**。州政府 2027 财年预算继续拨款。
summary.en: Since the 2025–26 school year, **every public school student in New York State** gets free breakfast and lunch, regardless of income or status, **with no application**. The state's FY2027 budget continues the funding.

zh: 纽约州公立学校学生
en: Public school students in New York State

zh: 不用申请，直接在学校领取
学校如果寄来家庭收入表，仍建议填写，可能帮学校争取更多经费
en: No application; just eat at school
If the school sends an income form, filling it in can still help the school's funding

sources.name: 纽约州长 2026 年 6 月公告

title.zh: 现金补助和 SSI 老人残障补助金

short.zh: 收入很低时的生活费补助；65岁以上或残障可申请SSI
short.en: Help with living costs for very low income; SSI for 65+ or disabled

summary.zh: 收入很低、难以维持生活的家庭，可以向 HRA 申请**现金补助**（Cash Assistance）。65 岁以上、失明或残障且收入很低的人，可以向社安局申请 **SSI**，2026 年在纽约独居单人每月最多 **$1,081**。
summary.en: Households with very low income can apply to HRA for **Cash Assistance**. People 65+, blind or disabled with very low income can apply to Social Security for **SSI**: up to **$1,081 a month** for one person living alone in New York in 2026.

zh: 现金补助：收入和资产很低；纽约州的 Safety Net 计划对移民较宽，据法律援助机构介绍包括庇护申请中、TPS、DACA 等身份（以 HRA 确认为准）
SSI：65 岁以上、失明或残障，收入和资产很低
SSI 移民规定较严：难民和庇护者最多 7 年；绿卡持有人一般需要工作满 40 季或符合其他例外
en: Cash Assistance: very low income and assets; NY's Safety Net Assistance is broader for immigrants, reportedly including pending asylum, TPS, DACA and others (confirm with HRA)
SSI: 65+, blind or disabled with very low income and assets
SSI immigrant rules are strict: refugees and asylees up to 7 years; green card holders usually need 40 work quarters or another exception

zh: 现金补助：用 ACCESS HRA 网上申请，或到 HRA 求职中心（Job Center）
SSI：打社安局电话预约，或到当地社安局办公室
两者都会有面谈，按时出席
en: Cash Assistance: apply on ACCESS HRA or at an HRA Job Center
SSI: call Social Security for an appointment or visit a local office
Both include an interview; attend on time

label.zh: 社安局（可要求中文翻译）

sources.name: 纽约州 2026 年 SSI 金额
社安局：移民领取 SSI 规定

title.zh: 冬季暖气补助（HEAP）

short.zh: 2026年11月2日开放，先到先得
short.en: Opens Nov 2, 2026, first come, first served

summary.zh: HEAP 帮低收入家庭付冬天的暖气费。**2026–27 年度一般补助 11 月 2 日开放**，紧急补助 2027 年 1 月 4 日开放，**先到先得**，钱用完就停，要早申请。4 口之家年收入 $82,230 以下可以申请。
summary.en: HEAP helps lower-income households pay heating costs. **Regular HEAP for 2026–27 opens November 2**, Emergency HEAP on January 4, 2027. It's **first come, first served** until funds run out, so apply early. A family of four can earn up to $82,230 a year.

zh: 收入在标准以内（4 口之家年收入 $82,230）
领粮食券或现金补助的家庭大多自动获得
家里有 60 岁以上、6 岁以下或残障人士的，可多拿补助
en: Income under the limit ($82,230 a year for 4)
Most SNAP or cash assistance households get it automatically
Extra for households with someone 60+, under 6, or disabled

zh: 纽约市：用 ACCESS HRA 申请
其他地区：向县社会服务局申请
长者可打 NY Connects 求助
en: NYC: apply through ACCESS HRA
Elsewhere: your county DSS
Seniors can call NY Connects for help

sources.name: 纽约州长 2026 年 10 月 HEAP 公告

title.zh: 半价地铁巴士卡（Fair Fares）

short.zh: 18–64岁低收入纽约市民，地铁巴士半价
short.en: Half-price transit for lower-income New Yorkers 18–64

summary.zh: Fair Fares 让低收入纽约市民坐地铁和巴士**半价**。目前收入标准是联邦贫困线 **150%**，市政府已提议放宽到 **200%**（单人约 $32,000、4 人约 $66,000），尚未生效。
summary.en: Fair Fares gives lower-income New Yorkers **half-price** subway and bus rides. The income limit is **150% of the poverty line**; the City has proposed raising it to **200%** (about $32,000 for 1, $66,000 for 4), not yet in effect.

zh: 住在纽约市、18–64 岁
没有从 HRA 领全额车费、也没有其他交通优惠
en: NYC resident aged 18–64
Income up to 150% of poverty: about $23,940 (1) or $49,500 (4) in 2026
Not getting full carfare from HRA or another transit discount

zh: 上 nyc.gov/fairfares 或 ACCESS HRA 申请
10 天内上传证明文件，30 天内审核
需要帮助打 311
en: Apply at nyc.gov/fairfares or on ACCESS HRA
Upload documents within 10 days; decisions take up to 30 days
Call 311 for help

title.zh: 免费报税和退税福利（EITC、儿童税抵免）
title.en: Free tax prep and tax credits

short.zh: 免费报税；有ITIN也能领纽约州儿童税抵免
short.en: Free filing; ITIN filers can get NY's child credit

summary.zh: 纽约市提供**免费报税服务**，家庭年收入 $97,000 以下（有受抚养人）或 $68,000 以下（没有）都能用，有中文服务点。很多低收入家庭能拿回**劳动所得税抵免（EITC）**，**用 ITIN 报税的家庭也能领纽约州儿童税抵免**。
summary.en: NYC offers **free tax preparation** for households earning up to $97,000 with dependents or $68,000 without, including sites with Chinese service. Many low-income workers get the **Earned Income Tax Credit**, and **ITIN filers can claim New York's Empire State Child Credit**.

zh: 免费报税（2026 报税季标准）：有受抚养人 $97,000、没有 $68,000 以下
联邦 EITC：需要社安号（SSN）；2026 税年最多 $664（没有孩子）到 $8,231（3 个以上孩子）
纽约州儿童税抵免：**SSN 或 ITIN 都可以**；2026 税年 4 岁以下每个孩子 $1,000、4–16 岁 $500
en: Free tax prep (2026 season): up to $97,000 with dependents, $68,000 without
Federal EITC: requires an SSN; tax year 2026 maximum from $664 (no children) to $8,231 (3+ children)
Empire State Child Credit: **SSN or ITIN**; tax year 2026: $1,000 per child under 4, $500 for ages 4–16

zh: 每年 1 月底到 4 月 15 日报税季，上 NYC Free Tax Prep 网站按语言找中文服务点
带齐 W-2、1099、身份证明、孩子的 SSN 或 ITIN、去年的报税表
填纽约州表格 IT-213 申请儿童税抵免
en: During tax season (late January to April 15), use the NYC Free Tax Prep finder to search by language
Bring W-2s, 1099s, ID, SSNs or ITINs for children, and last year's return
Claim the child credit on NY form IT-213

label.zh: 纽约州儿童税抵免说明

zh: “收入低就不用报税”：不报就拿不到 EITC 等退税，很多人因此少拿几千元
“报税会暴露身份”：ITIN 报税是合法的，纽约州儿童税抵免接受 ITIN
en: "Low income means no need to file": you can't get EITC refunds without filing
"Filing exposes my status": filing with an ITIN is legal and NY's child credit accepts ITINs

sources.name: 纽约市免费报税常见问题

title.zh: Lifeline 电话和上网优惠

short.zh: 每月上网费最多减 $9.25
short.en: Up to $9.25 off internet each month

summary.zh: Lifeline 是联邦的电话或上网优惠，每户每月上网最多减 **$9.25**，只有电话的减 $5.25。家里有人领白卡、粮食券等就符合。
summary.en: Lifeline is a federal discount of up to **$9.25 a month** on internet (or $5.25 for voice-only), one per household. You qualify if someone gets Medicaid, SNAP or similar benefits.

zh: 联邦通讯委员会（FCC）2026 年 2 月提议限制移民申请 Lifeline，**目前尚未定案**。
en: In February 2026 the FCC proposed limiting Lifeline by immigration status; **it isn't final**.

zh: 收入在贫困线 135% 以内，或家里有人领白卡、粮食券等
每户只能一个
en: Income up to 135% of poverty, or someone on Medicaid, SNAP or similar
One per household

zh: 向参加 Lifeline 的电话或网络公司申请，或上联邦 Lifeline 网站查资格
en: Apply through a participating phone or internet company, or check on the federal Lifeline site

sources.name: 国会研究处 Lifeline 报告

title.zh: 申请纽约公屋（NYCHA）

short.zh: 房租约为收入的30%，等候时间很长，要尽早排队
short.en: Rent is about 30% of income; the wait is long, so get on the list early

summary.zh: 纽约市房屋局（NYCHA）的公屋，房租约为家庭收入的 **30%**，大部分包水电暖气。申请免费、网上就能办，但轮候名单很长，官方也无法估计要等多久，所以越早申请越好。
summary.en: NYCHA public housing rent is about **30% of household income**, with most utilities included. Applying is free and online, but the waiting list is very long and NYCHA can't estimate wait times, so apply early.

zh: **Section 8 租房券目前不接受新申请**：NYCHA 和 HPD 的 Section 8 轮候名单都已关闭，只接受特定转介。网上自称“代办 Section 8”的多为骗局。
en: **Section 8 vouchers are closed to new applicants**: both the NYCHA and HPD waiting lists are closed except for specific referrals. Anyone offering to "get you Section 8" for a fee is likely a scam.

zh: **不一定要是公民**：家里至少一人是公民或有合格身份（如绿卡、难民、庇护）即可
混合身份家庭也能申请，房租会按有合格身份的人数比例计算
住在或在纽约市工作的人优先
老人公屋：单人申请须 62 岁以上；多人家庭的户主和所有成员都须 62 岁以上
en: **You don't have to be a citizen**: at least one household member needs to be a citizen or have eligible status (green card, refugee, asylee)
Mixed-status families can apply; rent is prorated by the number of eligible members
People who live or work in NYC get priority
Senior buildings: a single applicant must be 62+; in larger households the head and every member must be 62+

zh: 上网到 **ApplyNYCHA**（selfserve.nycha.info）建立账户并填写申请，申请时不需要上传文件
不会上网的，可以打电话请 NYCHA 寄纸本申请表
记下申请编号，之后用同一网站更新地址、收入和家庭人数
**每 24 个月要上网更新一次**，否则会被移出名单；更新不会改变你原来的排队日期
轮到你时会通知面谈，届时带齐原件
en: Go to **ApplyNYCHA** (selfserve.nycha.info), create an account and fill in the application. No documents are needed to apply
If you can't apply online, call NYCHA and ask for a paper application
Keep your application number and use the same site to update your address, income or household
**Renew every 24 months** or you'll be dropped from the list; renewing keeps your original filing date
When your turn comes you'll be called for an interview; bring originals

zh: 面谈时需要：全家人的身份证件和出生证明
社安卡或身份证明文件
收入证明（工资单、W-2、社安金或退休金信函）
目前住址证明
en: At the interview: ID and birth certificates for everyone
Social Security cards or immigration documents
Proof of income (pay stubs, W-2, benefit letters)
Proof of current address

label.zh: NYCHA 客服中心（周一至五 8am–5pm）

zh: “交钱可以插队”：NYCHA 申请完全免费，没有任何付费加快的方法
“没有身份就不能申请”：只要家里有一人有合格身份就能申请
“申请一次就不用管了”：24 个月不更新会被移出名单
en: "Pay to jump the line": applying is free and nobody can speed it up for a fee
"No status, no chance": one eligible member is enough
"Apply once and forget it": if you don't renew every 24 months you're removed

title.zh: 抽签平价房（Housing Connect）

short.zh: 不论身份都能抽，房租约为收入三分之一
short.en: Open to everyone regardless of status; rent about one-third of income

summary.zh: 纽约市的平价房通过 **NYC Housing Connect** 网站抽签分配，**不论公民或移民身份都可以申请**。每个楼盘都有收入下限和上限，只有收入落在范围内才有机会。
summary.en: NYC affordable apartments are assigned by lottery through **NYC Housing Connect**, and **anyone can apply regardless of citizenship or immigration status**. Each building has a minimum and maximum income; you only qualify where your income fits both.

zh: 任何人都可以注册申请，不问身份
收入要在该楼盘的范围内。2026 年标准（年收入上限）举例：1人 80% AMI 为 $95,040、130% AMI 为 $154,440；4人 80% AMI 为 $135,680、130% AMI 为 $220,480
部分楼盘优先给老人、残障人士和本社区居民
en: Anyone can register and apply; status isn't asked
Your income must fit the building's range. 2026 examples (yearly maximum): 1 person 80% AMI $95,040, 130% AMI $154,440; 4 people 80% AMI $135,680, 130% AMI $220,480
Some buildings give priority to seniors, people with disabilities and neighborhood residents

zh: 到 housingconnect.nyc.gov 注册账户，填好家庭人数和收入
浏览正在开放的楼盘，只申请收入范围符合的
**每个楼盘都可以申请，多申请几个机会更大**，申请完全免费
被抽中后会收到通知，需要在期限内交材料并面谈
另外留意“二次出租”（re-rental），是先到先得
en: Register at housingconnect.nyc.gov and enter your household size and income
Browse open lotteries and apply only where your income fits
**You can apply to every eligible building, and more applications mean better odds.** It's free
If selected you'll be notified to submit documents and interview by a deadline
Also watch re-rentals, which are first-come, first-served

zh: 被抽中后才需要：工资单、W-2、福利信函
银行和投资账户月结单
租房记录，可能会查信用
全家人的身份证件和出生证明
en: Only if selected: pay stubs, W-2s, benefit letters
Bank and investment statements
Rental history; credit may be checked
IDs and birth certificates for everyone

zh: “收入越低越好”：每个楼盘有收入下限，收入太低反而不合资格
“找中介可以保证抽中”：抽签是随机的，任何收费保证抽中的都是骗局
“填多一点收入比较好”：收入资料必须真实，被抽中后会严格核查
en: "Lower income is always better": each building has a minimum income too
"An agent can guarantee a win": lotteries are random; paid guarantees are scams
"Round your income up": figures must be accurate and are checked if you're selected

sources.name: NYC HDC 2026 收入与房租表

title.zh: 老人和残障人士租金冻结（SCRIE / DRIE）
title.en: Rent freeze for seniors and people with disabilities (SCRIE/DRIE)

short.zh: 62岁以上、收入5万以下，租金可以冻结不再涨
short.en: 62+ with income $50,000 or less: your rent stops going up

summary.zh: 如果你住在租金管制公寓，62 岁以上（SCRIE）或有残障（DRIE），家庭年收入 **$50,000 或以下**，而且房租超过收入的三分之一，就能申请把房租冻结在现在的水平，以后房东加租的部分由市政府抵税补上。
summary.en: If you live in a rent-regulated apartment, are 62+ (SCRIE) or have a qualifying disability (DRIE), have household income of **$50,000 or less**, and pay more than one-third of income in rent, your rent can be frozen at its current level. Future increases are covered by a city tax credit to your landlord.

zh: **2026 年租金稳定公寓全面冻租**：租金指导委员会 2026 年 6 月表决，10 月 1 日起开始的 1 年和 2 年租约**都不加租**。SCRIE/DRIE 则能让你的房租长期冻结，两者不冲突。
房东已就冻租提起诉讼，法官预计 2026 年底前裁决，在此之前冻租继续有效。
en: **2026 rent freeze for stabilized apartments**: in June 2026 the Rent Guidelines Board voted a 0% increase for 1- and 2-year leases starting October 1, 2026. SCRIE/DRIE freezes your rent long-term, so it's still worth applying.
Landlords have sued over the freeze; a judge is expected to rule by the end of 2026, and the freeze stays in place until then.

zh: SCRIE：62 岁以上，名字在租约上
DRIE：18 岁以上，并领取 SSI、SSDI、退伍军人残障金，或曾领 SSI/SSDI 而现在领残障白卡
全家年收入 $50,000 或以下
房租超过月收入的三分之一
住在租金稳定（rent-stabilized）、租金管制（rent-controlled）或其他受管制公寓；DRIE 也包括 Mitchell-Lama 等
**不适用**：NYCHA 公屋、Section 8 单位、分租和非管制公寓
en: SCRIE: 62+ and named on the lease
DRIE: 18+ and receiving SSI, SSDI, VA disability, or disability-related Medicaid after SSI/SSDI
Household income $50,000 or less
Rent more than one-third of monthly income
Rent-stabilized, rent-controlled or other regulated apartment (DRIE also covers Mitchell-Lama and similar)
**Not eligible**: NYCHA, Section 8 units, sublets, unregulated apartments

zh: 上网申请最快：搜索 “NYC Rent Freeze”，在官方网站填写
也可以用纸本表格，**有中文版**，寄复印件，不要寄原件
批准后房租冻结在申请时的金额
到期前 60 天可在网上 Tenant Access Portal 续期，记得按时续
en: Online is fastest: search "NYC Rent Freeze" and apply on the official site
Paper forms are available, **including in Chinese**. Mail copies, not originals
Once approved, rent is frozen at the amount when you applied
Renew through the Tenant Access Portal starting 60 days before it expires

zh: 现在的租约和续约
全家人去年的收入证明（报税表、社安金信函等）
年龄证明；DRIE 需要残障福利证明
en: Current lease and renewal
Last year's income proof for everyone (tax returns, benefit letters)
Proof of age; for DRIE, proof of disability benefits

label.zh: NYC Rent Freeze 官方网站

zh: “公屋也能申请”：NYCHA 和 Section 8 单位不适用
“申请了就永久有效”：要按时续期，否则会失效
“房东会因此赶我走”：这是合法福利，房东通过抵税拿回差价
en: "It covers NYCHA too": NYCHA and Section 8 units aren't eligible
"It lasts forever": you must renew on time
"My landlord will push me out": it's a legal benefit and the landlord gets a tax credit

title.zh: 被房东告上法庭：免费律师（Right to Counsel）
title.en: Facing eviction: free lawyer (Right to Counsel)

short.zh: 收入在贫困线2倍以内，被告驱逐可免费请律师
short.en: Free eviction lawyer if income is under 200% of poverty line

summary.zh: 在纽约市，如果房东在房屋法庭（Housing Court）告你欠租或要你搬走，收入在联邦贫困线 **200% 以内**的家庭可以**免费请律师全程代表**，**不论移民身份**。收入较高的也可以得到免费法律咨询。
summary.en: In NYC, if your landlord takes you to Housing Court for unpaid rent or to evict you, households under **200% of the federal poverty line** get a **free lawyer for the whole case, regardless of immigration status**. Others can get free brief legal advice.

zh: 住在纽约市的租客，包括 NYCHA 居民
全家收入在联邦贫困线 200% 以内可获全程代表：2026 年约 1 人 $31,920、4 人 $66,000
收入较高者可获简短法律咨询
不问移民身份
en: NYC tenants, including NYCHA residents
Full representation if income is under 200% of poverty: about $31,920 for 1 person and $66,000 for 4 in 2026
Brief advice for others
Immigration status doesn't matter

zh: **收到法庭文件不要不理**，不出庭会自动判你输
拨 311，说 “Tenant Helpline”
或打 Housing Court Answers 热线
第一次出庭时，直接向法庭要求免费律师
en: **Never ignore court papers**; missing court means you lose by default
Call 311 and ask for the "Tenant Helpline"
Or call Housing Court Answers
At your first court date, ask the court for a free lawyer

zh: 法庭文件（Petition、Notice）
租约和交租记录
收入证明
en: Court papers (petition, notice)
Lease and rent receipts
Proof of income

zh: “房东可以自己换锁赶人”：在纽约这是违法的，只有法院执行官才能执行驱逐
“没身份不能上法庭”：房屋法庭不问身份，也不会通报移民局
en: "My landlord can change the locks": illegal in NY; only a court marshal can evict
"Without status I can't go to court": Housing Court doesn't ask about immigration status

title.zh: 老人住房：老人公屋和老人平价楼

short.zh: 62岁以上可申请老人公屋、HUD 202 老人楼和老人抽签房
short.en: 62+: NYCHA senior buildings, HUD 202 buildings and senior lotteries

summary.zh: 62 岁以上的长者有三条路：NYCHA **老人公屋**、联邦 **HUD 202** 老人楼（直接向每栋楼排队），以及 Housing Connect 上**优先给老人的抽签楼盘**。三条路可以同时走。
summary.en: Seniors 62+ have three routes: NYCHA **senior buildings**, federal **HUD Section 202** buildings (apply to each building's waitlist), and **senior-priority lotteries** on Housing Connect. Use all three at once.

zh: NYCHA 老人公屋：单人 62 岁以上，或全家都 62 岁以上；收入和身份规定同一般公屋
HUD 202：至少一人 62 岁以上，收入一般低于地区中位收入 50%；很多楼同时有 Section 8 补贴，对移民身份有要求，请向每栋楼确认
Housing Connect 老人楼盘：按各楼盘规定
en: NYCHA senior buildings: single applicant 62+ or everyone 62+; same income and status rules as public housing
HUD 202: at least one member 62+, income generally under 50% AMI; many buildings also have Section 8 subsidies with immigration-status rules, so ask each building
Senior lotteries on Housing Connect: rules vary by building

zh: 在 ApplyNYCHA 申请公屋时选择老人楼（Senior Development）
HUD 202 要直接联系每栋楼的管理处登记轮候，可请 Aging Connect 帮忙找
在 Housing Connect 留意标明 senior 的楼盘
en: On ApplyNYCHA, choose senior developments
For HUD 202, contact each building's management office; Aging Connect can help you find them
On Housing Connect, watch for senior-designated lotteries

label.zh: Aging Connect 老人服务热线

zh: “老人楼只收公民”：不一定，各楼规定不同，混合身份家庭也值得逐栋询问
“只能排一个名单”：可以同时登记多个名单
en: "Senior buildings are for citizens only": not necessarily; rules vary by building, so mixed-status families should ask each one
"Only one list at a time": you can be on several lists

title.zh: 老人中心、送餐和老人服务
title.en: Older adult centers, meals and senior services

short.zh: 60岁以上免费：老人中心午餐、活动、上门送餐
short.en: Free for 60+: center meals, activities, home-delivered meals

summary.zh: 纽约市 60 岁以上长者可以免费到**老人中心**吃饭和参加活动，餐点会配合社区口味，很多华人区中心提供中餐。行动不便的可以申请**上门送餐**。一个电话 Aging Connect 就能查。
summary.en: New Yorkers 60+ can eat and join activities at **older adult centers** for free, with meals that fit the community's culture. Those who can't get out can get **home-delivered meals**. Start with one call to Aging Connect.

zh: 纽约市 60 岁以上居民
上门送餐：60 岁以上、外出困难，需经评估
en: NYC residents 60+
Home-delivered meals: 60+ and homebound, after an assessment

zh: 打 Aging Connect：212-AGING-NY（212-244-6469），说明需要中文翻译
或在 NYC Aging 网站用 “Find a center near you” 找附近老人中心
申请送餐：先电话登记，个案经理会上门评估
en: Call Aging Connect at 212-AGING-NY (212-244-6469); ask for an interpreter if needed
Or use "Find a center near you" on the NYC Aging site
For home-delivered meals: phone intake, then a case manager visits

title.zh: 纽约市身份证 IDNYC

short.zh: 免费、不问身份的市政府身份证
short.en: Free city ID regardless of immigration status

summary.zh: IDNYC 是纽约市政府发的**免费身份证**，10 岁以上的纽约市居民都能办，**不问移民身份**。可以用来进出政府大楼、在部分银行开户、去图书馆，还有博物馆等优惠。
summary.en: IDNYC is a **free photo ID** from the City for residents 10+, **regardless of immigration status**. Use it to enter city buildings, open accounts at some banks, use libraries and get museum and other discounts.

zh: 住在纽约市、10 岁以上
不问移民身份
en: NYC residents age 10+
Immigration status doesn't matter

zh: 上 IDNYC 网站预约，或打 311 说 “IDNYC”；新预约每周五开放
部分办理点有固定日子可不预约（walk-in），如皇后区中央图书馆逢周五
带身份和住址证明去办理，可用网站上的 Document Calculator 查哪些文件算数
卡有效 5 年（16 岁以下 2 年）
en: Book on the IDNYC site or call 311 and say "IDNYC"; new slots open each Friday
Some centers take walk-ins on set days, e.g. Queens Central Library on Fridays
Bring proof of identity and NYC address; the Document Calculator shows what counts
Valid 5 years (2 years under 16)

zh: 身份证明：护照、外国身份证、领事证等
纽约市住址证明：水电账单、租约、银行月结单等
en: Identity: passport, foreign ID, consular ID, etc.
NYC address: utility bill, lease, bank statement, etc.

title.zh: 免费 3-K 和 Pre-K 幼儿园

short.zh: 3岁和4岁孩子免费上学，不问收入和身份
short.en: Free school for 3- and 4-year-olds, any income or status

summary.zh: 纽约市为 **3 岁（3-K）和 4 岁（Pre-K）**的孩子提供**免费**全日制学前教育，**不论家庭收入、移民身份或语言**。每年年初截止申请，网上申请有中文版。
summary.en: NYC offers **free** full-day school for **3-year-olds (3-K) and 4-year-olds (Pre-K)**, **regardless of income, immigration status or language**. Applications close early in the year; the online form is available in Chinese.

zh: 当年满 3 岁或 4 岁、住在纽约市的孩子
不问收入和身份
en: NYC children turning 3 or 4 that year
No income or status requirement

zh: 到 MySchools（myschools.nyc）网上申请，有中文版
或到家庭欢迎中心（Family Welcome Center），或打 718-935-2009
按时申请的家庭都会获得学位，不是先到先得
2026–27 学年已于 2026 年 2 月 27 日截止；下一轮预计 2027 年初开放
en: Apply on MySchools (myschools.nyc), available in Chinese
Or visit a Family Welcome Center, or call 718-935-2009
Every family that applies on time gets an offer; it's not first-come
The 2026–27 deadline was Feb 27, 2026; the next round is expected to open in early 2027

sources.name: 纽约市长办公室 2026 年 2 月公告
